issues: Remove keywords entries for "fanfare" and "act"; these are timings and should only be represented as abilities, not in keywords.

The activated ability should use a single selected enemy follower for both clauses; encode it as destroying the selected enemy follower and dealing 3 damage to that follower's leader with a linked effect such as damageFollowerAndLeader, not as separate destroy-any-follower plus 3 damage to enemy leader.

Add the play restriction "This card can only be played if there are at least 3 Goblinoid followers on your field." The parser omitted this condition entirely; the engine needs a playable-condition ability/condition such as a field trait minimum with cardType follower.

The spell effect should destroy the selected enemy follower and deal 2 damage to its leader as one linked effect off the same target, not as two separate spell abilities. Encode as a single spell ability using a sequence or dedicated damageFollowerAndLeader-style operation after selecting one enemy follower.

The fanfare is targeted incorrectly: it should deal 2 damage to each other follower on your field, not to each enemy follower. Replace dealDamageAllEnemies with dealDamageOtherFollowers or an equivalent self-field-only effect excluding this follower.
Remove "evolve" and "fanfare" from keywords; they are timings/evolve metadata, not keywords.
Add the passive restriction "This follower can't attack enemy leaders." The parser omitted this clause; the engine needs a passive operation for 'can't attack leaders' or attack target restriction.

The activated ability's damage amount is wrong: X should equal the attack of the follower you put into the cemetery, not the selected target's attack. Implement a dynamic amount that references the buried card's attack or last paid-cost card stats.

The activated ability should target an enemy leader or an enemy follower in a single ability. Current encoding splits it into two duplicate abilities; use one target selector supporting leader-or-follower targeting if available, or add such a selector to the engine.

The condition "If there's a follower that costs 5 or more on your field" is encoded with unsupported condition type fieldFollowerMinCost. To be correct, use a field condition checking for at least 1 follower with minCost 5; the engine needs an implemented condition for field follower cost thresholds.
Remove "fanfare" and "act" from keywords; they are timings and should not be listed as keywords.
The quick activated ability is missing quick: true and activateFrom: "hand"; [q][act] with "discard this card" means it activates from hand during quick timing.

The activated cost is encoded incorrectly as {"discard": true}; it should discard this card from hand as part of the cost, which requires an implemented hand-activation self-discard cost or equivalent engine support.

Add the evolve restriction "Activate only if Overflow is active for you." The evolve ability is missing a condition {"type":"overflow"}; if evolve conditions are not currently supported on metadata-only evolve lines, the engine should support conditioned evolve abilities.

Add the passive restriction "This follower can't attack enemies." The parser omitted this clause; the engine needs a passive attack restriction operation for 'can't attack followers' / 'can't attack enemies'.
Remove "evolve" from keywords; evolve is represented by evolve metadata, not as a keyword.

The optional additional cost is encoded incorrectly: buryFromFieldSelect should be restricted to an amulet, but the current cost can bury any follower/card. Encode a field-select bury effect filtered to amulets; if not available, implement filter support on buryFromFieldSelect.

The damage amount should depend on whether the additional cost was paid, not be a free player choice between 3 and 5. Replace choose with conditional resolution based on optionalCost being paid; if the engine cannot track optional-cost-paid state, add support for that state in optionalCost/if handling.
